## Yvonne for Santa Clara City Council
## Why I'm Running
Growing up in Santa Clara, I saw firsthand what it looks like when city government isn't working for everyone. Families being priced out of their homes. Small businesses struggling to survive. Neighborhoods that feel left behind.
I'm running because District 2 deserves better! I will be a representative who listens, gets things done, and makes sure every taxpayer dollar works for this community.

###### TRUSTEE OF SUNNYVALE SCHOOL DISTRICT BOARD OF Education & President of California Association of Latino School Leaders (CALLE)
“I'm proud to endorse Yvonne Inciarte, who served as my Director of Intergovernmental Relations, for Santa Clara City Council District 2.
I've watched her spend years in government, serving the people of our district and tackling our most important issues.
She listens, she solves problems, and she cares about getting things done for our community. I have no doubt she'll serve the constituents of this district well.”
###### Congressman Ro Khanna, CA-17
